notes.title: Spooky Season update and Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Spooky season is upon us! And Christmas, and even Easter isn't that far away either. Connected to that we might have put some stuff in the game that you should definitely check out. 

Big question is: Can you figure out how? 

We've also fixed some issues!

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a case where the player could get stuck after speaking to Pesto and Bjoharn
[*] Fixed a case where Puriel would not be visible in the beginning of act 2.
[*] Made the "..of Sensibility" achievement less sensitive, it should now count a memory as "watched" when the player has seen more than 90%. Some players manually aborted playback before the video ended by itself, causing the achievement not to pop.
[*] The sidequest "For Inner Peace" should now complete as expected.
[*] Fixed a case where timewarped items could appear as permanent inside the wardrobe module, preventing players from removing them from the timewarp slots.
[*] Fixed some minor translation issues.
[*] Added a new UI font for Northern Sami translation.
[*] Added improved inventory filtering for some interactions where a bunch of cosmetics would get in the way.
[*] Set up a temporary hotline for Holiday John's Holiday Line.
[/list]

notes.title: The *genius* patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the player would be stuck on the fast forward screen while waiting for Elder 7 inside the vault. This was caused by some terrible logic surrounding whether or not the player had witnessed Elder 7 falling asleep. If the player had never witnessed this, the game believed it should cancel the fast forward at 15:00, when he falls asleep. So... two things could happen if the player never witnessed this:
1. The player could try to trigger fast forward before 15, the fast forward would then look normal and stop at 15. 
2. The player could try to trigger fast forward after 15, causing the game to try and fast forward a negative time value. Like... 15-18 = -3 I mean... this is just stupid. No one should let me near this code again.
[*] Added safety check to fast forward, so it is no longer possible to fast forward to the past.
[*] Fixed "on" button hitbox on God's coffee machine, forgot about that one.
[*] Cassiel should no longer say "There he is", when Sam Sr. is obviously not there.
[*] Fixed Joar Renolen's name in the credits. I swear to god... I think we've messed up his name a million times by now. We're so sorry!
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2 - The Nutsack Update
notes.notes:
Here it is, the long awaited nutsack update! We finally fixed the biggest issue in the game so far, along with some other small stuff.

The patch notes do contain some spoilers, so be warned!

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added New Game ++. Creating a new save in slot nr. 4 will now create a save where you start at the very end of act 1. This is purely for those wishing to hunt for achievements. PS: You will not be able to get the "...of Efficiency" achievement in this mode.
[*] Made the achievement "...of Paradoxicality" less missable.
[*] Made the achievement "...of Hostility" less missable by allowing players to brew themselves a cup of gods coffee in act 3. This will only work with a save file that has not reached act 3 yet.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Defusing the bombs and then traveling back in time to a point just after the bombs were defused leading to the bombs not being defused anymore.
[*] Giving Elder 7 a cup of coffee and then leaving to get another cup for him in the same timeline should now work as expected.
[*] Some minor one-off lines being said more than once.
[*] Edge case where the player was unable to speak to Pesto and Bjørn.
[*] Ensured cosmetic items you only ever need to have one of, are not picked up multiple times. Even though it's funny to pick up 1000 demon horns, it does make it a little bit of a hassle to navigate your inventory.
[*] Texture issue in god's house where toilet scrolls did not look like scrolls.
[*] Fixed awkward transition to God's House backyard, some players ended up immediately teleporting back where they came from.
[*] Elder 4 responding to Cassiel before she starts knocking.
[*] Russian translation now says "Last Tuesday", instead of "Last Thursday" - which was a wholly uneventful day for everyone.
[*] Norwegian translation has been improved.
[*] Satan's e-mail address is now his actual email address. We're really sorry Person-trying-to-live-your-life-and-not-get-tons-of-mails-addressed-to-Satan.
[*] Opening the vault door and then going back in time to when Cassiel mentions that it takes an hour, leads to player movement being locked.
[*] Annoying Ananiel until he leaves did not work.
[*] Inner vault lock now remembers where it was in its animation when going back in time.
[*] Fixed Mark Atherlay's name in the credits, we don't know who Mike is.
[*] [b]Sweary should now properly appear every time Gabriel says nutsack.[/b]
[*] Fixed various typos on Cassiels ID card
[*] You can no longer exit the coffee machine mini game after clicking the "on" button. The minigame will end on its own when it's good and ready, preventing strange situations where the portal to hell does not appear as expected.
[*] Improved coffee machine "on" button hitboxes.
[/list]

notes.title: The Holy Gosh Darn needs a little more time - coming September 26th!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We just wanted to let you all know The Holy Gosh Darn will be delayed slightly from its September 5th release date to a new date of September 26th, across Steam and all consoles. This isn't because of anything serious - just a small bump in the road! While you wait, why not wishlist the game on Steam, keep up to date with development on social media, and join our Discord community? Links to our social media can be found here: 

[url=discord.gg/87fVnp5]DISCORD[/url]
[url=https://x.com/PerfectlyParano]Twitter/X[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/perfectlyparanormal/]INSTAGRAM[/url]
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@perfectlyparanormalgames]TIKTOK[/url]

Here is an FAQ about why we've delayed the launch:

[b]Why have you delayed the launch - is the game broken / bad?[/b]
No! The game is great and almost entirely playable without any bugs! We're using the additional time for a few non-game-breaking bugs, and to build more hype!

[b]Why don't you use your fancy time control thingy to manipulate time and prevent the game from being delayed?[/b]
That's a lot of work!! Having to sit through meetings, skipping through so much dialogue about KPI's and USP's. It's like a whole thing! Not to mention all the throwing up we'd have to do from the time travel! We felt you all wouldn't mind waiting a few weeks.

[b]We don't want to wait, we want the game NOW![/b]
That's not a question!

[b]What if the thing I just asked about not wanting to wait was a question?[/b]
Well I guess that's a question. You're able to play the demo for the Holy Gosh Darn on Steam, Switch and Xbox while you wait.

[b]What if I've played the demo like a billion times?[/b]
A billion? Well, that's like a lot! You could play the other games in the Tuesday trilogy, Helheim Hassle and Manual Samuel, while you wait.

[b]What if I've also played them like a billion times?[/b]
I don't know, I guess you're our biggest fan and you could start speedrunning the games or something?

[b]How else can I pass the time and be further entertained?[/b]
We are uploading daily content to our socials, so check out the demon of the day and our other content. This is an excellent way to pass the time without throwing up.

notes.title: GAMINGAKSJONEN 2023
notes.notes:
Around this time every year Norway has a national charity event called “TV-aksjonen” in Norwegian. Millions on millions in donations is given every year. In this charity event one humanitarian organization is chosen as the recipient of all charities donated during the event. This year all donations go to Save The Children. In addition to the main event there are many connected events happening as well. 

One of these is the “Gamingaksjonen” a 24 hrs twitch stream that starts today at 12:00 Norwegian time. A stream focused on fact based guests talking about the important, and hyper relevant, work Save The Children are doing all over the world helping children that are victims to war and conflict, while also making an engaging stream with guests from the Norwegian game development scene, showcasing upcoming norwegian games and playing games with the community. Hosted by the great folks over at Level Up! 

[b]Of course this is something that Perfectly Paranormal wants to contribute to, and our amazing Ozan will be guesting and talking about the Holy Gosh Darn and a lot of other stuff as well. The upcoming Norwegian games part will start at 17:00 Norway Time. [/b]

The stream will be in Norwegian, but we hope as many as possible drops by, regardless, as the work Save The Children does knows no borders. 

You can watch the stream here live:
[url=http://twitch.tv/levelupnor]http://twitch.tv/levelupnor[/url]

More about save the children:
[url=https://www.reddbarna.no]Norwegian Site[/url]
[url=https://www.savethechildren.net]International Site[/url]
